prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Neptunium (Np) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one square 1:1 image, 1024×1024.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a hilltop observatory with its dome open to a clear night sky, a brass-railed platform around the great telescope
Time of day: night — the scene lit by lamps, screens or windows, dark outside; lamps lit inside, the window dark with night.
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a fitted knit dress with knee-high suede boots — in burnt rust orange; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; styled with a fitted vest buttoned over it and delicate drop earrings; right now — a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a waist-high railing or sill.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head turned with her body, the tip of her nose pointing toward the left of the frame; camera at her eye level; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on the sill, her elbow on the sill.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on the railing.
GAZE: she looks out of the window.
EXPRESSION: one brow raised higher, eyes wide and attentive, lips slightly parted.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — neptunium: the first element beyond uranium, a silvery metal caught in 1940 by firing neutrons into uranium, and named for the next planet out, the planet of the sea god, just as uranium was named for the planet before it; earlier claims to have found it under other names had all been mistaken; that planet itself was first found on paper, by calculating the pull of something unseen, before any telescope saw it; dissolved in water she changes colour with her state, purple, sea-green and pale pink, she lingers in faint traces in uranium ore, and one of her forms is used to breed the fuel that warms far-flung deep-space probes — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

generation.note: 원본 PNG 는 올리지 않는다 — sha256 만 남긴다

observations: 정사각형. 적갈색 니트 의상으로 천문대 창가에 기대어 한 손으로 턱을 받치고 다른 손은 난간에 둠.
젖은 표면이 확연하지 않고 참고 그림의 Np 장식이 조끼에 남음.
qa.cause: 젖은 옷 상황과 일상복 모티프 규칙이 덜 반영됨.

acceptance: 사용자 대표컷 2,1,2 선택 및 등록 승인
